title: Sequential composition of bounded executions
statement: Let $lim$ be resource limits, $P$ a program, $d$ a call depth, and $s_1,s_2$ statements. If, from a state $sigma$, the first statement ends within $T_1$ in a state from which the second statement ends within $T_2$ satisfying $Q$, and $T_1+T_2\le T$, then the sequential composition $s_1;s_2$ ends from $sigma$ within time $T$ satisfying $Q$.
